# Medical Prescription Attachment for WooCommerce Documentation

> Official documentation for Webkul's Medical Prescription Attachment for WooCommerce plugin, which turns a WooCommerce store into a compliant online pharmacy by requiring, collecting, and verifying a doctor's prescription before gated medicines can be purchased.

**When to use this documentation.** Use this site when you need to:

- Install or update the Medical Prescription Attachment for WooCommerce plugin on a WordPress site (requirements, upload, activation, first-run setup).
- Decide which products or categories require a doctor's prescription, and configure how the "Prescription Required" label and upload box appear on product, shop, cart, checkout, and order pages.
- Configure plugin behaviour: allowed file formats and counts, multiple uploads, Attach Later, Re-Upload If Rejected, order notes, admin and customer email notifications.
- Set up the optional OCR and AI reading of uploaded prescriptions, including OCR languages, the confidence threshold, and the Google Gemini Vision fallback for handwriting.
- Answer how-to questions about the customer experience: uploading a prescription, attaching one later, the My Prescriptions vault, My Pill Box, and the frontend prescription search.
- Answer how-to questions about store-owner workflows: reviewing an upload, approving or rejecting it, the four prescription statuses, the audit trail, and the three plugin emails.
- Troubleshoot prescription gating on an existing WooCommerce store using this specific Webkul plugin.

Do not use this site for WooCommerce core documentation, for other prescription or pharmacy plugins, or for Webkul's Magento, Shopify, or Odoo products. It is not medical, pharmaceutical, or legal advice: it documents software behaviour only, and compliance with the prescription-medicine rules of your jurisdiction remains the store operator's responsibility.

**How to consume this site.** Every documentation page is available as raw markdown: append `.md` to the page URL (e.g. `https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/installation.md`), or request any HTML URL with `Accept: text/markdown`. The full corpus in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/llms-full.txt). Machine-readable page list: [sitemap.xml](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/sitemap.xml).

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/index.md): What the Medical Prescription Attachment plugin does: block prescription-only medicines in WooCommerce until a doctor's prescription is uploaded and approved.
- [Features](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/features.md): Every feature of the WooCommerce prescription plugin: product and category gating, upload rules, OCR and AI reading, admin review, emails, and compatibility.
- [Installation](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/installation.md): Install Medical Prescription Attachment for WooCommerce: requirements, upload from the WordPress admin or by FTP, first-run setup, verification, and updating.
- [How It Works](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/how-it-works.md): The lifecycle of a prescription order in WooCommerce, from gating a product to customer upload, blocked checkout, admin review, approval, and rejection retry.
- [General Settings](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/configuration-general.md): The General settings tab: master toggle, Allowed Categories, multiple file uploads, file count and formats, Attach Later, Re-Upload If Rejected, order notes.
- [Labels & Display](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/configuration-labels-display.md): Customise the Prescription Required label text and colours, and choose where the label and upload box appear on product, shop, cart, checkout, and order pages.
- [Notifications](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/configuration-notifications.md): Turn admin and customer prescription emails on or off, see how they map to the three WooCommerce templates, and get the recommended notification setup.
- [OCR & AI](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/configuration-ocr-ai.md): Set up optional OCR and AI reading of prescriptions: OCR languages, confidence threshold, Gemini Vision fallback for handwriting, plus privacy and cost notes.
- [Optional Features](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/configuration-features.md): Enable the optional v1.3.x extras: the My Pill Box chronic disease organiser and the frontend prescription search engine, plus its layout display location.
- [Product & Category Setup](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/product-setup.md): Two ways to require a prescription in WooCommerce: mark a single product, or gate a whole category with Allowed Categories, and how the two rules interact.
- [Uploading a Prescription](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/customer-upload-flow.md): How a customer uploads a prescription: the label, the drag-and-drop attach box, checkout enforcement on classic and Blocks, file validation, and what follows.
- [Attach Later & Re‑Upload](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/attach-later-reupload.md): Two optional prescription flows: let logged-in customers order now and upload later from My Account, and let them resubmit a new file after a rejection.
- [My Prescriptions Vault](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/my-prescriptions-vault.md): The My Prescriptions vault in WooCommerce My Account: customers view submitted prescriptions, check status, and upload pending ones. Includes endpoint setup.
- [My Pill Box](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/my-pill-box.md): My Pill Box, the chronic disease pill organiser: customers save named health folders of medicines and re-order them in one click, with gating still enforced.
- [Prescription Search](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/frontend-search.md): The frontend prescription search: a shopper uploads a prescription image and the storefront filters products to the medicines it mentions. A discovery aid only.
- [Order Management](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/admin-order-management.md): The admin review desk for prescription orders: read an upload with OCR-extracted details, approve or reject it, and follow the order-note audit trail.
- [Prescription Statuses](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/prescription-statuses.md): The four prescription statuses, Attachment Pending, Pending, Approved and Rejected: how they flow, where they appear, and how they differ from order status.
- [Email Notifications](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/email-notifications.md): The three WooCommerce emails this plugin ships for prescription orders, who receives each one, how to enable them, and how to customise the templates.
- [FAQ & Troubleshooting](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/documentation/faq.md): Answers to common Medical Prescription for WooCommerce questions: missing labels, allowed categories, file types, Blocks checkout, OCR accuracy, and emails.

## About this publisher

- [About](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/about.md): Webkul, founded 2010 in Noida India, publishes the Medical Prescription Attachment for WooCommerce plugin. About the plugin, the company, and these docs.
- [Contact](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/contact.md): Contact Webkul for Medical Prescription for WooCommerce support, sales, and licensing: ticket portal, email, phone, and the company address in Noida, India.
- [Privacy](https://wpdoc.webkul.com/medical-prescription/privacy.md): How this documentation site handles data: no accounts, no forms, no trackers. Prescription files stay on your own WordPress site, never on Webkul's servers.

Published by Webkul Software Private Limited, an eCommerce software company founded in 2010 and based at H-28, ARV Park, Sector 63, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India. Support: support@webkul.com, +91-9870284067, https://webkul.uvdesk.com/.
